title: Vice President, MSP and Cybersecurity Technology Toolset Lead at IT Services and Consulting Firm Expects Samsara-Related Business to Grow 8%–11% in 2026
expert: VP running a ~25-person MSP practice deploying Samsara for SMB and mid-market field-service and transport clients
verdict: The practice's Samsara sales rose nearly 10% y/y in Aug–Oct, ahead of plan on renewals and module expansion, but pilots are stretching out.

Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🟡 CY26 Samsara business +8%–11% (estimate), pipeline weighted to new logos; vs 2026-11-05 call's 25%–27%: lower (SMB/mid-market).
🔴 Evaluation phases and pilots stretching out, as buyers measure outcomes beyond GPS; first read on deal cycles (mgmt called cycles 'about the same' on 2026-09-03). → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↓
GM/FCF through component cycle: 🟡 List prices +3%–5% (estimate), realized pricing blurred by multi-module packaging and discounts; vs 2026-11-05 call (+5%–7% platform, ≤2%–3% basic): in line. → Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost) →
Competition & share: 🔴 Deeper discounts needed vs Verizon Connect and Trimble, vs Jefferies aggressive-price competitors (SB #62604): confirming. → Tenet 4 (platform moat) ↓

changes: Growth outlook: CY26 +8%–11% vs 2026-11-05 call's +25%–27%: lower.
Deal cycles: pilots stretching out; first read, vs mgmt 'sales cycles about the same' (thesis page, 2026-09-03): conflicting.
Pricing: +3%–5% (estimate) vs 2026-11-05 call's ≤2%–3% basic / +5%–7% platform: consistent.
Competition: discounts vs Verizon Connect and Trimble vs Jefferies aggressive-price competitors (SB #62604): confirming.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion): → — sales +nearly 10% and higher renewal spend, offset by longer pilots.
Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost): → — +3%–5% list price, partly discounted away.
Tenet 4 (platform moat): ↓ — deeper discounts needed vs Verizon Connect and Trimble.
